messages:
Rina - Partnerships: Quick check-in: we need a short 'Practice Bench' plan for SI onboarding that includes sandbox access, a practice exam, and a fast-track badge for proof-of-success. Can folks weigh in on required artifacts and timelines?
Victor - SI Programs: I propose: 1) practice sandbox with 25 seats per SI, 2) 20-question practice exam (non-graded) with annotated answers, 3) a 48-hr verification window for badges. Timeline: ready in 12 working days.
Lina - Enablement: We'll author the annotated practice exam + a one-page study guide. Needs from docs: glossary + CLI screenshots. ETA 7 days if we freeze content today.
Kai - Field Eng: Sandbox infra: can spin up a shared tenant in us-east + eu-west, but each SI needs isolation. I can seed quotas and a canned workload generator. Request: provide expected concurrent users per SI.
Maya - Marketing: Badge creative: 2 variants (standard, fast-track). Fast-track unlocked if SI proves end-to-end deploy in <60 minutes or scores >=90% on exam. Need partner logos and consent for co-branding.
Rina - Partnerships: OK. Two policy questions: 1) do we allow retroactive badges for already onboarded SIs? 2) what identity proofs do we require to avoid fraudulent claims?
Victor - SI Programs: Retroactive badges: allow if SI completes practice exam + deployment verification within 30 days. Identity: corporate email + partner contact verification should suffice for now.
Lina - Enablement: For trainer readiness, we'll run a 45-min 'how to proctor' session and record it. Recommend making the practice exam open for 7 days before the main cert window.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Seed SI sandboxes" in 5 days (2834568200).
Kai - Field Eng: Noted. Also will add a smoke-check script that validates model loading, token billing, and demo latency. I'll add threshold defaults to the repo.
Maya - Marketing: I'll draft badge copy and a partner one-pager. Need to know the fast-track pass criteria final decision by EOD Friday.
Rina - Partnerships: Decision: fast-track criteria = either 90% practice score OR successful <60min E2E deploy with all smoke checks passing. Action items recap: Victor=practice exam + verification flow, Lina=study guide + trainer session, Kai=sandbox infra + smoke scripts, Maya=badge assets + one-pager, Rina=partner communications & consent form. Aim to close in 12 working days.
Victor - SI Programs: I'll post the practice exam draft here once ready.
Rina - Partnerships: Thanks team. Flag any blockers here. :sparkles:
